DEPTH_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Outer depth from the rear wall to the room face of the front partition when Enter creates without a pull. 21 Bunk: 730 mattress + 18 partition.

DECK_TOP_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Top of the lower bunk deck (the lower box's top) when Enter creates without a pull. 21 Bunk: tunnel boot 400 + deck 18.

DECK_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Lower bunk deck, which is also the tunnel boot's lid. 21 Bunk: 18 partition stock.

PARTITION_THICKNESS_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Front partition thickness when the params give none. A new bunk copies the job's partition stock thickness instead. 21 Bunk: 18.

BUNK_CLEAR_MIN_MM.doc: Least clear height over each mattress base (lower: deck top to the upper base underside; upper: upper base top to the bunk top). Set by hand; 21 Bunk has 759.5 on both.

BOOT_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Lowest tunnel boot under the deck. Set by hand.

LENGTH_MIN_MM.doc: Shortest bunk, wall to wall. Set by hand; 21 Bunk is 2275.

DEPTH_MIN_MM.doc: Shallowest bunk including the front partition. Set by hand; 21 Bunk is 748.

LOWER_RAIL_MM.doc: Front partition above the lower deck top before the lower opening starts: the lower bunk's guard. 21 Bunk: deck top 418 → opening 548.

UPPER_BASE_LIP_MM.doc: The lower opening stops this far under the upper base, so the partition covers the upper base's front edge. 21 Bunk: underside 1177.5 → opening top 1147.5.

UPPER_RAIL_MM.doc: Front partition above the upper base top before the upper opening starts: the upper bunk's guard. 21 Bunk: 1201.5 → 1326.5.

OPENING_WALL_MARGIN_MM.doc: Both bunk openings start this far from the side wall away from the ladder; the upper opening also ends this far from the ladder-side wall. 21 Bunk: 600 → 1675 (2275 − 600).

OPENING_RADIUS_MM.doc: Corner radius of the bunk openings. 21 Bunk: R100 (one corner in the STEP is R120, taken as a drawing slip).

LADDER_HOLE_COUNT.doc: Hand holes in the front partition beside the lower opening: the ladder to the upper bunk. 21 Bunk: 3.

LADDER_HOLE_WIDTH_MM.doc: Width of each ladder hole. 21 Bunk: 250.

LADDER_HOLE_GAP_MM.doc: Partition between two ladder holes. The holes share the lower opening's height, so their height follows. 21 Bunk: 166.5 high each.

LADDER_HOLE_RADIUS_MM.doc: Corner radius of the ladder holes. 21 Bunk: R30.

LADDER_HOLE_EDGE_MM.doc: The ladder holes' outer edge sits this far inside the upper opening's ladder-side edge. 21 Bunk: 1675 → 1655.

LADDER_WEB_MM.doc: Partition between the lower opening and the ladder holes. 21 Bunk: 1325 → 1405.

BOOT_ACCESS_WIDTH_MM.doc: Opening in the front partition for the tunnel boot door, from the floor to the deck underside. 21 Bunk: 925 → 1360.5.

BOOT_ACCESS_FROM_END_MM.doc: From the ladder-side wall to the near edge of the boot access opening. 21 Bunk: 2275 − 1360.5.

SHEET_SHORT_MM.doc: Usable short side of a 1220 × 2440 sheet (border removed). Same limit as the partition walls.

SHEET_LONG_MM.doc: Usable long side of a 1220 × 2440 sheet (border removed). Same limit as the partition walls.

SPLIT_ROUND_MM.doc: A partition too big for one sheet is butt-cut once at its middle, rounded to this. 21 Bunk: 2275 / 2 → 1140.

CUBBY_WIDTH_MM.doc: End cubby at the ladder-side wall: from the end panels' cubby face to that wall. 21 Bunk: end panels at 1975 → 1991, wall at 2275.

END_HOLE_SIDE_MM.doc: Hand hole in each end panel: this far from the partition and from the rear wall. 21 Bunk: 80 → 650 on a 730 deep panel.

END_HOLE_TOP_MM.doc: Hand hole in each end panel: its top edge this far under the panel's top. 21 Bunk: 679.5 on a 759.5 high panel.

END_HOLE_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Hand hole in each end panel: height. 21 Bunk: 429.5 → 679.5.

END_HOLE_RADIUS_MM.doc: Hand hole in each end panel: corner radius. 21 Bunk: R30.

BOOT_DOOR_OVERLAP_MM.doc: The tunnel boot door covers the access opening by this much on each side, on the room face of the partition. 21 Bunk: door 915 → 1370.5 over 925 → 1360.5.

BOOT_DOOR_BOTTOM_GAP_MM.doc: Tunnel boot door: gap above the floor. 21 Bunk: 3.5.

BOOT_DOOR_TOP_OVERLAP_MM.doc: Tunnel boot door: its top passes the deck underside (the top of the access opening) by this much. 21 Bunk: 400 → 408.5.

BOOT_DOOR_LOCK_LENGTH_MM.doc: The boot flap's catch (门扣): lock slot through the door, overall across, round ends included, centred on the door. 21 Bunk: straight 39 + ends 16 = 55.

BOOT_DOOR_LOCK_WIDTH_MM.doc: Lock slot height; the ends are half circles of half this. 21 Bunk: 357.75 → 373.75.

BOOT_DOOR_LOCK_DROP_MM.doc: Lock slot centre below the deck underside, where the catch fastens. 21 Bunk: 400 − 369.25. The kitchen's lock uses 30.5 with a 15.5 slot.

BOOT_DOOR_HINGE_DIAMETER_MM.doc: The boot door is a down flap: hinge cup diameter, on its inside face. Same as every flap.

BOOT_DOOR_HINGE_DEPTH_MM.doc: Flap hinge cup depth (the tall and overhead flaps' 12).

BOOT_DOOR_HINGE_FROM_EDGE_MM.doc: Hinge cup centre up from the flap's bottom (hinge) edge. The hinge plates fix to the sill's top behind the door.

BOOT_DOOR_HINGE_FROM_SIDE_MM.doc: Two hinge cups along the bottom edge, centres this far from each side (the flap rule of the tall and overhead cabinets).

LEDGER_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Strips under the upper base, cut from the partition stock and standing on edge: one against the rear wall wall to wall, one against the partition from each side wall to the first opening. Their top is the upper base underside. 21 Bunk: 2275 × 100 at the back.

SILL_DEPTH_MM.doc: Tunnel boot sill on the floor: the part behind the boot's inner sides, into the boot. 21 Bunk: 45.

SILL_OVERHANG_MM.doc: The sill runs this far past its tongue on each side, behind the inner sides. 21 Bunk: 545 = 435 + 2 × 55.

SILL_TONGUE_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: The sill's tongue fills the access opening through the partition and the inner side, this much short, flush on the side away from the ladder. 21 Bunk: 435 in a 435.5 opening.

SILL_RELIEF_DIAMETER_MM.doc: Router relief at the two inner corners where the tongue meets the sill: a half circle cut into the sill along its edge, so the inner sides' square corners seat. 21 Bunk: Ø11 (router 10 + 1).
